title: Bottleneck Analysis
scenario: For each status, find the average time a bug stays in that state before transitioning to the next state.
tableSchema: status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP)
hint: Use LEAD() to find the timestamp of the next status change.
correctQuery: SELECT status, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_changed_at - changed_at))/3600) FROM (SELECT status, changed_at, LEAD(changed_at) OVER(PARTITION BY bug_id ORDER BY changed_at) as next_changed_at FROM status_history) t GROUP BY status;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE status_history (bug_id INT, status VARCHAR, changed_at TIMESTAMP);
